items.title: WishTick
items.description: Digital wish diary: add, track, and analyze your dreams

detail.overview: WishTick is a wish diary app that helps you structure your dreams, track progress, and find inspiration.
detail.role: Full frontend development: design, architecture, implementation of all features, deployment.
detail.challenge: The main challenge was to create an intuitive interface for keeping a wish diary with filtering and statistics.
detail.solution: Used React Router for navigation, JSON Server for API simulation, implemented search, sorting, and statistics visualization.
detail.results: The app helps users not forget about their wishes and see the progress of their fulfillment.

items.title: Babushka Market
items.description: Online antique store with cart and notifications

detail.overview: Babushka Market is an online antique store with a vintage design and a fully functional shopping cart.
detail.role: Full development: from design to deployment on Vercel.
detail.challenge: Create an atmospheric store with a convenient cart and notifications.
detail.solution: Used React Router for navigation, React Toastify for notifications, TypeScript for typing.
detail.results: A vintage-style store with a fully functional cart and pleasant notifications.

items.title: Swagger Editor App
items.description: Visual OpenAPI/Swagger specification editor with REST client
items.role: Developed the visual OpenAPI specification editor, implemented REST client and Netlify deployment. Participated in code reviews and task distribution in a team of 3.

detail.overview: Swagger Editor App is a full-featured OpenAPI specification editor with a REST client for API testing.
detail.role: In a team of 3, I developed the visual editor, REST client, and set up Netlify deployment.
detail.challenge: Create a convenient tool for working with OpenAPI specifications that can be used in production.
detail.solution: Implemented a syntax-highlighting editor, API integration, and Netlify deployment.
detail.results: A ready-to-use product for visually editing specifications and testing APIs.

items.title: Interview Simulator
items.description: Interview preparation simulator for technical interviews
items.role: Implemented the simulator interface, question generation logic, and API integration. Worked in a team of 5, conducted code reviews.

detail.overview: Interview Simulator is a tool for preparing for technical interviews by generating questions and evaluating answers.
detail.role: In a team of 5, I developed the simulator interface, question generation logic, and API integration.
detail.challenge: Create a realistic interview simulator with different difficulty levels.
detail.solution: Implemented a question generator with difficulty levels, a timer for answers, and a scoring system.
detail.results: A working simulator that helps developers prepare for technical interviews.

items.title: Portfolio Website (this site)
items.description: Business card website with localization, dark theme, and animations

detail.overview: This site is my portfolio, built in a modern style with support for two languages and a dark theme.
detail.role: Full development: from design to deployment on Vercel.
detail.challenge: Create a site that both showcases my skills and serves as a finished product.
detail.solution: Used Next.js, Tailwind, Framer Motion, Shadcn/ui, localization, dark theme, and CI/CD.
detail.results: A completed portfolio ready to be shown to employers.
